name: What does kitchen cabinet removal involve?

mainEntity.name: What does kitchen cabinet removal involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen cabinet removal involves carefully unfastening, dismantling, and taking out existing upper and lower cabinetry, trim, and mounting hardware. The process begins with clearing out contents, shutting off relevant plumbing or electrical feeds, and removing doors, drawers, and countertops. Technicians then unscrew the face frames and back panels from the wall studs to avoid tearing drywall. If you plan to donate, sell, or relocate the boxes, crews use gentle pry techniques rather than destructive demolition to preserve structural framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen cabinet removal includes disconnecting utilities, removing doors and countertops, and unfastening cabinet boxes from wall studs without tearing the drywall.
